cards.name: Kirara (Summoner)
cards.desc:
Up until now, I’ve mostly been supporting you from behind the scenes,
but from now on, I hope I can be the one to lead you forward...
All right! Lamp, let’s keep giving it our all together!

cards.name: Lamp (Summoner)
cards.desc:
Just as you'd expect from a goddess-in-training, my swordsmanship is top-notch... or at least it will be!
Wait, no, that's not quite right.
After all, I'll just be hiding behind Ms. Kirara and the rest of the Creamate crew forever.
I'll do my best!

cards.name: Claire (Summoner)
cards.desc:
Can I come along too?
I’ve always just waited for you to come back from Village...
But I want to be more helpful to all of you!
I’ll do my best!

cards.name: Archive (Summoner)
cards.desc:
Chief Priest, Arshiv
I’ll help you as you asked.
By the way, have you seen Sora?
I see. She snuck out of the temple again today...
Never mind. Just forget I mentioned it. Anyway, please take good care of things.

cards.name: Media (Summoner)
cards.desc:
My name is Media.
I usually spend my time copying "Sanctuary" at the Scribes' Guild, but...
It seems you've called upon me as a Magician this time.
I'll do my best to be of help!

cards.name: Sumeragi Utsutsu (Summoner)
cards.desc:
Okay, wait a second.
Why on earth did you summon that Tawil, who’s got nothing but trashy abilities...?
You probably think he’s already blown himself up anyway...
Ugh... I’m sorry I got summoned.

cards.name: Highpris (Summoner)
cards.desc:
Hyphris
I swear to use this power for those in the world who cannot be saved.
I believe this will be my way of repaying Sora, who forgave someone like me, and of repaying Etowaria.
